# main_driver { #wass2s.main_driver }

```python
main_driver(
    dir_save,
    clim_start,
    clim_end,
    target_date_str,
    variables_list=None,
    ratio_mode='monthly',
    precip_source='era5',
    agera5_version='2_0',
    sst_source='era5',
    force_download=False,
)
```

Run monthly diagnostics with optional AgERA5 and NOAA ERSSTv6.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type            | Description                                                                                                              | Default   |
|----------------|-----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| precip_source  | (era5, agera5)  | Source used only for precipitation. SST is controlled independently by ``sst_source``; the remaining variables use ERA5. | `"era5"`  |
| agera5_version | str             | AgERA5 version requested from the CDS when ``precip_source="agera5"``.                                                   | `"2_0"`   |
| sst_source     | (era5, ersstv6) | Monthly SST source. ``"ersst"``, ``"noaa"`` and ``"noaa-ersstv6"`` are accepted aliases for ``"ersstv6"``.               | `"era5"`  |
| force_download | bool            | Re-download the selected monthly data even when a cached output exists.                                                  | `False`   |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> main_driver(
...     "./data", 1991, 2020, "2026-07-01",
...     variables_list=["sst"], sst_source="ersstv6",
... )
```
